There is no evidence of obfuscation, malicious payloads, or unauthorized system modifications. The changes are transparent and limited to build configuration. This patch enhances security hygiene by removing post-link script execution, reducing the attack surface during packaging.

Such patches are typical in AUR packages where maintainers disable upstream deployment mechanisms that are not needed or preferred in the Arch Linux ecosystem.
</details>
